default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win11cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win11cis_rule_1_1_3 }}
command:
  win11cis_1_1_3_minimumpasswordage:
    title: "1.1.3 | Ensure 'Minimum password age' is set to '1 or more day(s)' | MinimumPasswordAge"
    exec: |-
      powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p = Join-Path '{{ .Vars.win11cis_snapshot_dir }}' 'SystemAccess.MinimumPasswordAge'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { 'NONCOMPLIANT not_collected' } else { $r = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($r -notmatch '^[0-9]+$') { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $r } else { $v = [int]$r; if ($v -ge {{ .Vars.win11cis_minimum_password_age }}) { 'COMPLIANT' } else { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $v } } }"
    exit-status: 0
    stdout:
      - '/^COMPLIANT$/'
    stderr:
      have-len: 0
    timeout: {{ .Vars.timeout_ms }}
    skip: {{ if not .Vars.win11cis_domain_joined }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      workstation: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 1.1.3
      NIST800-53R5:
        - IA-5(1)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_1/cis_1.1.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_1/cis_1.1.x/cis_1.1.3.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

The role skips this on domain-joined hosts, where domain policy governs it.

odvs.description: win11cis_minimum_password_age is the policy setting determines the number of days that you must use a password before you can change it. The range of values for this policy setting is between 1 and 999 days. (You may also set the value to 0 to allow immediate password changes.) The default value for this setting is 0 days. The recommended state for this setting is: 1 or more day(s)
odvs.name: minimum_password_age

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.1.3 | PATCH | Ensure Minimum password age is set to 1 or more days"
  when:
    - win11cis_rule_1_1_3
    - not discovered_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_1.1.3
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
  block:
    - name: "1.1.3 | PATCH | Ensure Minimum password age is set to 1 or more days | Set Variable"
      when: win11cis_minimum_password_age <= 999 or win11cis_minimum_password_age > 0
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: MinimumPasswordAge
        value: "{{ win11cis_minimum_password_age }}"

    - name: "1.1.3 | AUDIT | Ensure Minimum password age is set to 1 or more days | Warning check for minimim password age"
      when: win11cis_minimum_password_age > 999 or win11cis_minimum_password_age == 0
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid age set for win11cis_minimum_password_age, please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "1.1.3 | AUDIT | Ensure Minimum password age is set to 1 or more days | Set warning count"
      when: win11cis_minimum_password_age > 999 or win11cis_minimum_password_age == 0
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '1.1.3'
